children: Current White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia has been ousted, according to three people familiar with the matter, New York Times reported Friday.

Zacharia has been under scrutiny due to how she presented her legal career and how she handled her press briefing. Her role as White House press secretary began on Oct. 12 and has reportedly lasted until Oct. 16.
President Donald Trump was questioned by reporters outside the White House and said, “Maybe the role is not for her.” He mentioned that he told her she did not have to stay in her role.
“I’m going to let her make the decision,” he said. “If I were her, I’d reconsider.”
Zacharia preceded Karoline Leavitt, who served the White House from January 2025 to August 2026.
The White House didn't immediately respond to Seeking Alpha’s request for comment.
